title: Reinforcement World Model Learning for LLM-based Agents
abstract: arXiv:2602.05842v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance in language-centric tasks. However, in agentic settings, LLMs often struggle to anticipate action consequences and adapt to environment dynamics, highlighting the need for world-modeling capabilities in LLM-based agents. We propose Reinforcement World Model Learning (RWML), a self-supervised method that learns action-conditioned world models for LLM-based agents on textual states using sim-to-real gap rewards. Our method aligns simulated next states produced by the model with realized next states observed from the environment, encouraging consistency between internal world simulations and actual environment dynamics in a pre-trained embedding space. translated_title: 面向基于大语言模型智能体的强化世界模型学习
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在以语言为中心的任务中取得了出色的表现。然而，在智能体场景中，大语言模型往往难以预见动作后果并适应环境动态，这凸显了基于大语言模型的智能体对世界建模能力的需求。我们提出了强化世界模型学习（RWML），这是一种自监督方法，利用模拟到真实的差距奖励，在文本状态上为基于大语言模型的智能体学习动作条件化的世界模型。我们的方法将模型生成的模拟下一状态与环境观测到的实际下一状态进行对齐，促使模型内部的世界模拟与实际环境动态在预训练嵌入空间中保持一致。与下一状态词元预测不同——后者优先考虑词元级别的保真度（即复现确切的措辞）而非语义等价性，并可能导致模型崩溃——我们的方法提供了更稳健的训练信号。
tldr: 该论文提出强化世界模型学习（RWML），一种自监督方法，通过在预训练嵌入空间中对齐模型模拟的下一状态与环境实际观测到的下一状态，为基于大语言模型的智能体学习动作条件化的世界模型，相比词元级预测提供了更稳健的训练信号并避免了模型崩溃。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Reinforcement World Model Learning (RWML), a self-supervised method that learns action-conditioned world models for LLM-based agents by aligning simulated next states with real environment observations in a pre-trained embedding space, offering a more robust training signal than token-level prediction while avoiding model collapse.
